title: The Big Yam
lines: Ted and Sal dig up yams in the sun.
Ted tugs and tugs, but the yam sits.
"I can not get it up," said Ted.
Sal digs a gap at the top of it.
Yes! Ted tugs, and the yam pops up!
It is as big as a pot.
Mom cuts up the yams in a big pan.
Ted and Sal had yams and buns. Yum!

questions.ask: What were Ted and Sal digging up?
questions.listenFor: Yams. The first line says it. If your child is not sure, point at that line and let them read it again.

questions.ask: What did Sal do that helped the big yam come up?
questions.listenFor: She dug a gap around the top of it. Line four says it. This is the turn of the story.

questions.ask: Do you think Ted could have got the yam up on his own? Tell me why you think that.
questions.listenFor: Either answer counts. You are listening for a reason tied to the story, such as he tugged and tugged and it did not budge.
